items.informal_name: Sum of a Multivariate Polynomial Over Its Support
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {b : (σ →₀ ℕ) → R → A}, Finsupp.sum p b = ∑ m ∈ p.support, b m (MvPolynomial.coeff m p)
items.informal_description: For any additive commutative monoid $ A $, multivariate polynomial $ p $, and function $ b : (\sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N}) \to R \to A $, the sum $ p.\text{sum}\, b $ equals the summation over all monomials $ m $ in the support of $ p $ of $ b(m, \text{coeff}_p(m)) $. This expresses the polynomial's sum as a finite combination of its non-zero monomials weighted by $ b $.

items.informal_name: Polynomial Sum Equality with Subset Support
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] {p : Polynomial R} (f : ℕ → R → S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → ∀ {s : Finset ℕ}, p.support ⊆ s → p.sum f = ∑ n ∈ s, f n (p.coeff n)
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, and any function $ f : \mathbb{N} \to R \to S $ where $ S $ is an additive commutative monoid, if $ f(i)(0) = 0 $ for all $ i \in \mathbb{N} $, and $ s $ is a finite set of natural numbers containing the support of $ p $, then the sum of $ p $ with respect to $ f $ equals $ \sum_{n \in s} f(n)(a_n) $, where $ a_n $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $. The support of $ p $ is the set of exponents with non-zero coefficients.

items.informal_name: Sum over Support of Monomials Equals Polynomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ∑ v ∈ p.support, (MvPolynomial.monomial v) (MvPolynomial.coeff v p) = p
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, the sum of the monomials $ v $ in the support of $ p $ multiplied by their respective coefficients equals $ p $. In symbols, $ p = \sum_{v \in \text{support}(p)} \text{monomial}(v) \cdot \text{coeff}(v, p) $.

items.informal_name: Multivariate Polynomial as Sum of Monomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  p = ∑ v ∈ p.support, (MvPolynomial.monomial v) (MvPolynomial.coeff v p)
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, $ p $ can be expressed as the finite sum $ p = \sum_{v \in \text{support}(p)} \text{monomial}(v) \cdot \text{coeff}(v, p) $, where $ \text{support}(p) $ denotes the finite set of monomials with non-zero coefficients in $ p $.

items.informal_name: Definition of Polynomial Sum Using Coefficients and Support
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : ℕ → R → S),
  p.sum f = ∑ n ∈ p.support, f n (p.coeff n)
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $ and any function $ f : \mathbb{N} \to R \to S $ where $ S $ is an additive commutative monoid, the sum of $ p $ with respect to $ f $ is equal to the sum over all exponents $ n $ in the support of $ p $ of $ f(n)(a_n) $, where $ a_n $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $.

items.informal_name: Polynomial as Sum of Monomials over Support
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), p = ∑ i ∈ p.support, (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, $ p $ is equal to the sum of $ \text{coeff}(p, i) \cdot X^i $ for all $ i $ in the support of $ p $, where the support denotes the finite set of exponents with non-zero coefficients.

items.informal_name: Weighted total degree of a multivariate polynomial
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring R] →
      {σ : Type u_3} → [AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : SemilatticeSup M] → [OrderBot M] → (σ → M) → MvPolynomial σ R → M
items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and a weighting function $ w : \sigma \to M $ where $ M $ is a sup-semilattice, this function computes the supremum of the weights $ w(s) $ over all monomials $ s $ in the support of $ p $. The weight $ w(s) $ of a monomial $ s $ is defined as the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } s} s(i) \cdot v_i $ for some fixed vectors $ v_i $ associated with indices $ i $. The result is an element of $ M $ representing the weighted total degree of $ p $.

items.informal_name: Sum of a Monomial in Multivariate Polynomial Ring Equals Its Term
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] {u : σ →₀ ℕ} {r : R}
  {b : (σ →₀ ℕ) → R → A}, b u 0 = 0 → Finsupp.sum ((MvPolynomial.monomial u) r) b = b u r
items.informal_description: For any additive commutative monoid $A$, commutative semiring $R$, and type $\sigma$, if $b : (\sigma \to₀ \mathbb{N}) \to R \to A$ satisfies $b(u, 0) = 0$ for a monomial $u$, then the sum of the monomial $\text{monomial}(u, r)$ over $b$ equals $b(u, r)$. This expresses that summing a single monomial term in the multivariate polynomial ring $R[\sigma]$ reduces to evaluating $b$ at the monomial's exponent vector and coefficient, provided $b$ annihilates zero coefficients.
